<span style="font-size:25px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Kenya&#39;s Secluded Beach Escape</span></h1></div><div id="comp-k7c3yriz" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-k7c3yriz wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;">For more than four decades, Che Shale has been one of Kenya&rsquo;s best kept secrets. Tucked away on the secluded northern coast, this is where the wild beauty of nature leads the way and every day is a barefoot adventure. Our intimate lodge sits in a quiet bay with miles of untouched coastline. With just nine uniquely designed bandas, Che Shale offers space, seclusion, and the unhurried escape you deserve.<span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
